title: iFeature: Sky Babylon
description: A surreal CG world built for iFeature's Sky Babylon.
overview: Sky Babylon moves through a monumental, otherworldly landscape where architecture fractures, floats and reforms around the performer.
The visual language combines stormy atmosphere, sculptural destruction and cinematic scale to give the official video a sense of constant transformation.

stills.caption: The first structure breaks apart into the storm.
Fragments suspended in the Sky Babylon world.
A monumental environment caught in transition.
